name: Multiresolution B-Spline Volume Rendering
aliases: Image order direct volume rendering with spline wavelets
definition: An image order direct volume rendering algorithm based on spline wavelet decomposition of the underlying data, which improves rendering quality and image accuracy while reducing memory requirements and allowing error bound calculation.
summary: Multiresolution B-Spline Volume Rendering is an image-order direct volume rendering algorithm that uses cardinal B-spline wavelet decomposition and a two-level linked list to improve quality, reduce memory, and enable error bounds.
